$comment: E-059 S2a (delivery_plan_v26.md slice 6b; engineering/roadmap/E-059/S1_FINDINGS_6B.md §8 and its operator decision of 2026-09-24). Written by run_campaign._decide_next_step (orchestrator.decide_next.enabled) from tools/decide_next.py::decide, through run_phase1_research.save_yaml, which checks it against this file by stem (warn-only by default, blocking under WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=raise). Pinned against a real decide() output by tests/test_e059_s2a_decide_next.py. The record never carries hypothesis_family, altitude, lineage_routing, hypothesis_verdict or continuation_* (decide() refuses campaign_memory.RETIRED_FIELDS), and has no lineage-demotion field (operator decision 6). Proposal scores appear here only. E-059 S2b: rules.r2 fires (asks step 1a for more hypotheses on open briefs), picked gains the card and R2-request shapes, and candidates include a brief's waiting extra cards (origin brief, kind card), whose 1a scores also appear here only.
title: runs/<run>/artifacts/decision_record.yaml
description: One decide-next decision, taken after the run's queue entry was marked done: the inputs' fingerprints, R1/R2, operator entries, every candidate considered with its gates, cost and rank, and what was picked (or why the loop stopped).

idea_status.description: From campaign_memory.yaml (the grid), never from pending_stage.

parked.description: Slice 6c S2c: present only on a decision taken after the run parked (waiting_for_<kind>); absent on the DONE decision.

feed_set_sha256.description: E-035 S2c: present only when some proposal carried requires_feed and the feed set (decide_next.load_feed_set: FEED_REGISTRY + RESERVED_FEED_REGISTRY keys, components' consumes_feeds) was computed.

fired.description: Always false without orchestrator.composition_runs (the recorded no-op). E-060 S3b, with it: true when a composition was picked this decision.

timeframes.description: E-060 S3b (composition_runs only): one row per exact bar size carrying forecast blocks.

fired.description: E-059 S2b: true when nothing was scheduled, no candidate was eligible and at least one open brief is eligible.

eligible_briefs.description: Open briefs whose owner is not superseded/paused/blocked and that are under the empty-R2 limit.

held_briefs.description: CUL-398: open briefs with an R2 request on an operator hold (blocked_on_* other than the automatic blocked_on_component:<name> quarantine): R2 neither flips nor mints a request for them until the hold is released. Absent in records written before CUL-398.

no_new_hypothesis_briefs.description: Open briefs at BRIEF_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_EMPTY_R2 consecutive empty R2 requests (the caller marks them exhausted).

legacy_briefs.description: No brief_status (operator decision 7): tagged obsolete, never trigger R2.

status.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): blocked_on_operator_approval when orchestrator.operator_approval held the request at apply time (run_campaign.py --approve <id> releases it); ready otherwise.

ready.description: Every R2 request decide-next made schedulable (code-review fix 3). Under orchestrator.operator_approval they are held instead: see awaiting_approval.

awaiting_approval.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when orchestrator.operator_approval held R2's requests at apply time -- each is blocked_on_operator_approval until run_campaign.py --approve <id>.

quarantine_capped_briefs.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when non-empty. Open briefs with at least decide_next.BRIEF_MAX_COMPONENT_QUARANTINES (3) component-quarantined (blocked_on_component:) entries -- the owner's own and its R2 requests, after any reopen marker. R2 stops asking them; the brief is NOT closed and is eligible again once entries are released.

status.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when orchestrator.operator_approval held the picked entry at apply time (run_campaign.py --approve <id> releases it).

oneOf.description: E-059 S2b: a brief's waiting extra card, flipped queued -> ready.

status.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when orchestrator.operator_approval held the picked entry at apply time (run_campaign.py --approve <id> releases it).

oneOf.description: E-059 S2b: R2's ready request (new: minted now; false: a waiting one flipped ready).

status.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when orchestrator.operator_approval held the picked entry at apply time (run_campaign.py --approve <id> releases it).
E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when orchestrator.operator_approval held the picked entry at apply time (run_campaign.py --approve <id> releases it).

kind.description: card (E-059 S2b): a brief's extra hypothesis whose card 1a already wrote. side_finding (E-068 slice 5, D-073): a v3 reader's side finding, a claim block pre-filled into the brief.

hypothesis_id.description: Reader: <parent>__<proposal_id> (operator decision 1). Card: the card's own id.

brief_owner.description: E-059 S2b, kind card only: the entry owning the brief (null for a legacy brief).

exact_match.description: Binding (operator decision 3): REPEAT makes the candidate ineligible.

spec_hashes.description: E-068 slice 5, kind side_finding only: the spec_hash of each test of its claim (information; a repeat is a warning, never a refusal).

digest_advisory.description: LEGACY family-grain exclusion digest lookup (build_exclusion_digest.legacy_family_lookup; the 'neighbour' outcome is legacy). Information only: never refuses.

requires_feed.description: E-035 S2c: present only when the candidate's proposal carries requires_feed (decide_next.requires_feed_gate). The candidate is INFEASIBLE unless status=wired or consumed=false, with reason requires_feed_reserved:<feed> (status reserved: needs a campaign_data_policy.yaml designation) or requires_feed:<feed> (status unknown: needs an acquisition; or no feed set supplied). Coverage of the run's venue/symbols/windows stays the data-availability gate's check at step 3.

status.description: The data-availability gate's own classification (reserved first, then FEED_REGISTRY); null when no feed set was supplied.

consumed.description: Whether the candidate's resolved config consumes the feed (aux_feeds or a component class's consumes_feeds); null without a resolved config (a new_block, an unresolved patch) or without a feed set.

warnings.description: E-068 PR 4 (D-071): present only when non-empty. WARNING ONLY (never a feasibility reason, never a change of eligibility or rank): a component class name the reader wrote that is neither a known class nor quoted from the run's hypothesis card (reader_proposals.unknown_class_names), with the nearest real name.

oneOf.description: E-068 slice 5: a side finding's test with the same spec_hash as a recorded finding (own_claim false) or as the source run's own claim test (own_claim true).
E-068 slice 5: a side finding whose claim kind names a block but no test reads that block's output (CLAIM_TESTS.md's visibility rule).
